notes: 分享方式去掉「微信传文件（.zip）」（这条路走不通，还每版白占 4MB）；分享面板新增「用其他应用打开」，签名工具认这条通路；「分享 IPA」额外注册 public.data / public.item，修掉部分签名工具列不出本应用；更新源加两条 jsDelivr 备路，国内检查更新更稳；主界面流光背景速度提到约 6 秒一轮
notesEn: Removed the WeChat .zip share option (it never worked and cost 4MB per build). Added "Open in Another App" (document-open path, more reliable for signing tools). "Share IPA" now also registers public.data / public.item. Two extra jsDelivr mirrors for update checks. Home-screen fluid background sped up to ~6s per cycle.
